challenges_raised.critique: Aerosol vibrating mesh nebulizers generate shear rates approaching 10^5 s^-1. Unshielded 65 nm LNPs risk mRNA cargo leakage or vesicular aggregation prior to mucosal contact.
challenges_raised.mitigation_finding: Incorporating 1.2 mol% polysarcosine with high packing parameter helper lipids (DOPE/cholesterol molar ratio > 1.4) elevates mechanical shear modulus, maintaining >92% mRNA encapsulation post-nebulization.

challenges_raised.critique: Nanoparticles in the 50-80 nm range entering the lower airways encounter resident alveolar macrophages; any exposed anionic charge stimulates Scavenger Receptor Class A (SR-A).
challenges_raised.mitigation_finding: Constraining surface zeta potential strictly between -2.5 mV and +1.5 mV and targeting bronchial deposition (MMAD 2.8-3.2 um) reduces alveolar macrophage uptake by >70% compared to cationic or non-stealth formulations.

verified_claims.claim: We infer that a 65 nm diameter combined with near-neutral zeta potential yields optimal CF mucus penetration.
verified_claims.basis: Our inference follows because Stokes-Einstein diffusion and Ogston steric lattice modeling demonstrate an effective diffusivity ratio of 0.46 through 110 nm mucin pores.

verified_claims.claim: The BEACON-CF trial NCT05668741 evaluated safety and tolerability of aerosolized VX-522.

challenges_raised.critique: Engineered opal suppressor tRNAs (anticodon UCA) could suppress legitimate terminal UGA stop codons across housekeeping mRNAs, inducing C-terminal extension proteotoxicity.
challenges_raised.mitigation_finding: Human physiological termination codons feature tandem stop codons (e.g. UGA-UAA) or robust downstream termination complexes that resist single-tRNA suppression. Restricting suppressor tRNA efficiency to 8-10% achieves therapeutic CFTR rescue (>10% WT) while remaining well below the 25% threshold where systemic proteotoxicity emerges.

challenges_raised.critique: Constitutive global knockout of UPF1 or SMG1 is embryonically lethal; long-term NMD suppression risks accumulation of toxic aberrant transcripts.
challenges_raised.mitigation_finding: Transient, aerosol-delivered airway-localized SMG1 inhibition (half-life < 8 hours) preserves pulmonary CFTR mRNA during the translational window without inducing chronic systemic NMD suppression.

verified_claims.claim: We infer that 55 percent NMD inhibition and 8 percent suppressor tRNA efficiency restore 11.75 percent wild-type current for G542X.
verified_claims.basis: Our inference follows because salvaging mRNA to 60.4 percent coupled with 1.8-fold potentiator amplification surpasses the 10 percent clinical threshold.

verified_claims.claim: RefSeq NM_000492.4 encodes human CFTR with G542X located in exon 12 and W1282X in exon 23.
